cohort: Sixty women (30 in each group) with a previous cesarean section and unfavorable cervix who required induction of labor after 28 weeks of gestation were included.
finding: Both Foley catheter and low dose oxytocin were effective cervical ripening agents in patients with previous CS, but the low dose oxytocin group had two cases of scar dehiscence, raising safety concerns.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery rates were 66.7% in the Foley group and 60% in the oxytocin group.
